falsification_conditions.condition: Price increases by 10% above the 200-day moving average within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A strong upward trend would contradict the expectation of a bottom pattern, invalidating the HOLD signal.
A significant increase in blowoff score would indicate a confirmed sell-off, directly contradicting the current HOLD verdict.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume surges by 200% above the 30-day average within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a volume spike would signal strong market conviction in a directional move, invalidating the uncertainty of the HOLD call.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
